home.title: Home
home.description: charpente — Rust API, Vue SPA, Nuxt site: types generated end to end from the Rust code.
home.headline: The load-bearing frame for your next product
home.subheadline: An Axum API, a Vue 3 SPA, a Nuxt site — with types generated end to end from the Rust code. Decide once, inherit everywhere.

flow.title: Types flow one way
flow.body: openapi.json is derived from the Rust code's utoipa annotations; Hey API generates the TypeScript client, the TanStack Query helpers and the Zod schemas from it. Nothing is written twice, so nothing can drift — CI's generated-check job fails on any diff.
flow.kicker: Rename a field in a Rust DTO: the Vue component using it goes red a few seconds later.

decided.title: Decided once, inherited everywhere
decided.intro: The conventions that are expensive to settle mid-project are already settled — and enforced by CI, not by discipline.

errors.title: Errors you can switch on
errors.body: RFC 9457 problem+json with a stable code — generated client-side as an exhaustive TypeScript union.

pagination.title: One pagination, everywhere
pagination.body: Cursors over time-ordered UUIDv7 ids; every list returns items, next_cursor, has_more.

auth.title: Server-side sessions
auth.body: argon2id with explicit parameters, sessions in Postgres, signed HttpOnly cookie, rotation at login, dummy verify against timing attacks.

uploads.title: Files never travel through the API
uploads.body: Presigned URLs to any S3: the API validates and records, the browser uploads directly.

events.title: One wide event per request
events.body: One structured JSON line per request, id returned to the client — the SPA reports its failures with the same id.

permissions.title: Permissions, not ifs on roles
permissions.body: Role::permissions in Rust, can() and {'<'}Can{'>'} in Vue. Adding a role means editing one function — not every guard.

gates.title: CI carries the load
pr: pedantic clippy — unwrap and panic denied
tests with a transactional database per test
Playwright + axe against the production image

scope.title: Deliberately out of scope
scope.intro: Decided, not forgotten: every absence is an ADR, with its estimated cost to add.

rows.cost: High — decide before writing the schema

rows.why: Wide events already stream to stdout
Which is why there is no cookie banner
rows.cost: Low — but reopens the consent question

rows.why: Owned: add them before the first real deployment
rows.cost: Low to add, unbounded to skip

closing.title: One project, one command
closing.body: And later, copier update pulls starter improvements into your project — a three-way merge that keeps your choices.
